title: Buggy
body: Love this app and have used it for years but recent builds have been buggy. I currently cannot type unless I tap on the screen a few times.
author: Levi (Kenya)

title: STOP ASKING TO REFRESH EVERYTIME I USE THE APP
body:
Google - you guys seem to be pushing the limit; I'm totally tired of refreshing the app Everytime I want to use it!!!!!

COME ON GUYS DO SOMETHING
author: Viztz
